name: Frame watchdog advisory recovery
logic_name: Persist and reconstruct bounded hash-only watchdog state per exact frame

test_list.description: The latest watchdog snapshot reconstructs from durable JSON and foreign-frame replay is rejected.
Older frame records without the optional watchdog field produce no snapshot and remain parseable.

inputs.name: frame_step_records
inputs.description: Newest first, bounded by FrameJournalLimits and checked against expected frame identity.

output_description: Hash-only records and negative fingerprints are recovered for the exact owning frame.
